to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    if count_input is nothing:
        return
    let count be value of count_input
    let totals be a map from text to number
    repeat count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by " "
        let item_name be item 1 of parts
        let change be (item 2 of parts) as number
        if totals contains item_name:
            set item item_name of totals to (item item_name of totals) + change
        otherwise:
            set item item_name of totals to change
    let item_names be keys of totals
    for each i from 1 to length of item_names:
        let item_name be item i of item_names
        let output_parts be an empty list of text
        add item_name to output_parts
        add (item item_name of totals) to output_parts
        say output_parts joined with " "
